# Motif

> Public SDK and CLI for fal.ai image, video, editing, and utility endpoints, built for agent-readable dry runs, schema introspection, and local automation.

## Start Here

- [README](./README.md) - User-facing overview, install commands, model registry, CLI examples, and options reference.
- [Agent instructions](./AGENTS.md) - Cross-tool commands, package map, permission boundaries, and verification expectations.
- [Security notes](./docs/security.md) - FAL_KEY handling, local history exposure, and ephemeral generation limits.
- [Surface scorecard](./docs/surface/scorecard.md) - Current agent-readiness score and dimension summary.

## What do you want to do?

Pick the `motif` command by task. The last column is the same advice `motif --describe tasks` gives; `apps/cli/AGENTS.md` has every command.

| Task | Command | Instead, when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Make an image from a prompt, or edit with -e | `motif "prompt"` | Taking one object out (erase), changing an existing image's ratio (reframe), or a consistent set of images (series run). |
| Give an image a house look and light | `motif "prompt" --look <id> [--mood <id>]` | Keeping one style, with references, across many images (series create --look). |
| Remove an object and fill the gap | `motif erase "what" [image]` | An object with a visible shadow (tool finegrain-eraser), putting something else in the gap (tool bria-genfill), text (tool text-removal), or the whole background (--rmbg). |
| Extend the canvas to a new aspect ratio | `motif reframe --og [image]` | Outpainting by a set margin (tool bria-expand or flux-outpaint), several sizes at once (tool smart-resize), or a new image at a given ratio (generate with -a or a preset). |
| Cut out or mask a named thing | `motif segment "what" [image]` | The background behind the main subject (--rmbg), every region without a prompt (tool sam2-auto), video (tool sam3-video), or boxes without masks (ask --detect). |
| Caption, count, detect or ask about an image | `motif ask "question" [image]` | Transcribing a page of text (tool got-ocr), content moderation (tool nsfw), or pixel masks (segment). |
| Upscale, restore, denoise or sharpen | `motif enhance [image]` | A quick Clarity upscale of the last generation (--up), colourising a black-and-white photo (tool ddcolor), or video (tool topaz-video). |
| Split an image into transparent layers | `motif layers [image]` | Named, z-ordered object layers (tool seedream-layerize), separating text from artwork (tool ideogram-layerize-text), or one masked object (segment). |
| Trace a raster image to a clean SVG | `motif vectorize [image]` | Pixel-faithful tracing with many paths (tool image2svg), or drawing a new image from a prompt (generate). |
| Lay images out on a captioned contact sheet | `motif sheet <images...>` | Making the images (generate or series run), or combining images into one new picture (generate with several -e). |
| Make a consistent set of images from a theme | `motif series run "theme"` | One image (generate), several takes of the same prompt (generate with -n), or variations of the last image (--vary). |
| Keep a reusable style, references and history | `motif series <subcommand>` | A one-off themed set (series run creates or reuses a series for you), or a house register for one image (generate with --look). |
| Other fal utilities: depth, 3D, relight, OCR | `motif tool list` | Anything a command covers. erase, reframe, segment, ask, enhance, layers and vectorize make the same calls and put the saved path at the top level. |
| Open the interactive terminal Studio | `motif studio` | Agents and scripts, which call the commands directly with --format json. |
| Remove the background from the last image | `motif --rmbg` | Taking one object out (erase), masking a named thing (segment), or generating with transparency from the start (generate with --transparent). |
| Make variations of the last image | `motif --vary` | A planned set of different scenes in one style (series run), or a specific change to an image (generate with -e). |

## Image generation and editing

- [Image SDK](./packages/motif-sdk/README.md#image-layer-howellsmotif-sdkimage) - `@howells/motif-sdk/image`: `createMotifImage()` generates and edits across providers. OpenAI tiers select GPT Image 2.5 Flare (fast/balanced) or Sunburst (quality/hero), using `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Explicit model ids override tiers; 2.5 per-image costs are unknown unless supplied by the provider.

Fal CLI / `FalClient`: `flare` and `sunburst` select GPT Image 2.5 generation and edit endpoints using `FAL_KEY`. Supports masks, transparency, 16 references, and `xhigh` / `max` quality. `estimateCost()` returns `null` for these metered models.

## Fal Tools

71 fal endpoints beyond generation, reached by `motif tool run <id>` or one of seven promoted verbs (`segment`, `ask`, `erase`, `reframe`, `enhance`, `layers`, `vectorize`). Read the live registry from `motif tool list --format json`; never hardcode ids or prices.

- [Understanding images](./docs/tools/understanding-images.md) - segment, ask, detect, OCR, and the segment-then-edit pipeline.
- [Preprocessors](./docs/tools/preprocessors.md) - depth, pose and edge control maps, and which downstream model consumes each.
- [Repair and restore](./docs/tools/repair-and-restore.md) - erase vs generative fill vs Topaz, and when the $0.024 eraser beats the $0.27 one.
- [Layers, vectors and materials](./docs/tools/layers-vectors-materials.md) - what layerize actually returns, generate-then-vectorise, photo-to-PBR.
- [Pipelines](./docs/tools/pipelines.md) - chained one-liners, field masks, and where each command family puts its output path.
- [Example regeneration script](./docs/tools/regenerate.sh) - reproduces every example image; prices first, refuses to spend without an explicit flag.

Two invariants: `estimatedCost: null` means metered or per-unit billing, not free; and 29 of the 71 entries are `queued` and route through fal's queue because they outrun the 120-second synchronous window.

## Packages

- [CLI package](./apps/cli) - `@howells/motif-cli`, the `motif` binary, terminal Studio, CLI tests, and package-specific agent guide.
- [SDK package](./packages/motif-sdk) - `@howells/motif-sdk`, model metadata, fal request normalization, SDK types, and mocked fetch tests.

## Agent Interfaces

- [CLI describe command](./apps/cli/src/commands/describe.ts) - Runtime schema for commands, models, tools, leaderboards, errors, and enums.
- [CLI structured output](./apps/cli/src/utils/output.ts) - JSON, NDJSON, field masks, and structured error emission.
- [CLI input hardening](./apps/cli/src/utils/input.ts) - Prompt sanitization, output paths kept inside the git root, and option validation.
- Series discovery: use `motif --describe series --format json`; `motif series run "theme" --count n --dry-run --format json` plans cohesive themed image sets before spending credits.
- Creative direction: `generate`, `vary` and `series` accept two prompt-enrichment fields, `--look <id>` (12 house looks, e.g. `editorial`, `lived-in`, `ephemera`) and `--mood <id>` (6 light moods, e.g. `window`, `overcast`, `nocturne`), via CLI flags or a `creative` object. In `generate` a look also sets the default model and aspect when none is given. Five flat looks (`plate`, `engraved`, `ephemera`, `canvas`, `object`) refuse a mood with `INVALID_OPTION`. `series create --look --mood` pins both on a Series for every later `series gen` and `series run`; `--no-mood` (stdin `"mood": null`) drops a mood. Dry-run and generate JSON carry advisory `warnings` about the caller's own prompt. A fal account out of credit fails with `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` (exit 3, not retriable). Discover current ids, and each look's defaults, with `motif --describe --format json`.
- Contact sheets: `motif sheet <files...>` or `motif sheet --last <n>` lays images out on one captioned PNG (model, look, mood, cost from history). `-e/--edit` takes one path per flag and repeats. `-m gpt2 --transparent` runs through OpenAI and needs `OPENAI_API_KEY`; a transparent run whose PNG has no transparent pixels fails with `TRANSPARENCY_MISSING`.
- [SDK server](./packages/motif-sdk/src/server.ts) - Result-returning fal client, queue polling, upload support, and payload deletion.

## Tests

- [CLI contract tests](./apps/cli/tests/cli-contract.test.ts) - Help, dry-run, stdin JSON, structured errors, tool commands, and fal body previews.
- [SDK request tests](./packages/motif-sdk/tests/server-fetch.test.ts) - Mocked fal fetch behavior, no-store headers, and request payload deletion.
- [CI workflow](./.github/workflows/ci.yml) - Typecheck, lint, and tests on push and pull request.
